in_hebrew.name: Morley
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Morley הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English elements mor 'moor' and leah 'clearing'. This name suggests a connection to the land and could be a fitting choice for a child born in a rural or agricultural area.

in_latin.name: Morley
